title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, March 6, 2027
description: This is a live orchestra concert where the Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea, and Dvorak's New World Symphony. The program showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at the Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
